summary:
Decoder instance leak in libavcodec/libsvtjpegxsdec.c. The SVT JPEG XS
wrapper was added in 8.0; libsvtjpegxsdec.c does not exist in 7.1.5.
Refs:
  - https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-125240
  - https://code.ffmpeg.org/FFmpeg/FFmpeg/commit/3aa561b0dd2054182fbb9548b4526e8500d52a52
